from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document summary."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="The document identifier used in the summary (e.g., '判决文书 1', 'Document 2')")
    case_title: str | None = Field(description="The case title or parties involved, e.g., '何柏忠诉中华人民共和国自然资源部'")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The explicit cause of action stated in the judgment document, e.g., '政府信息公开', '行政给付'")
    act_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the administrative act described, e.g., 'Payment Obligation', 'Punishment', 'Information Disclosure'")
    excerpt: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the summary confirming the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
